summary: CarParts.com filed an 8-K on May 11, 2026 reporting an amendment to its Tax Benefits Preservation Plan (poison pill) that accelerated the expiration date from April 5, 2027 to May 12, 2026, effectively terminating the plan. The amendment, between the company and Computershare Trust Company as rights agent, caused all rights to expire immediately after close of business on May 12. A press release announcing the termination was issued. This is a routine governance change to a shareholder rights plan, not a transformative event, with no structural or strategic implications beyond the plan's discontinuation.
